what_this_is: The plan asks that a random draw of formula compositions the criterion did NOT flag be reviewed by hand, so that a criterion which simply misses things cannot pass as a criterion which finds nothing to find. Thirty were drawn from the 184 unflagged compositions with seed 20260822, recorded in t2_measurement_before.json. Each is judged below by reading its text.

verdict_vocabulary.genuine: the annotation is correct; this is mathematics, a symbol, a rule, a bullet or an undecodable glyph run, and it should not be translated
verdict_vocabulary.missed_text_fragment: the annotation is wrong -- this is ordinary text -- but the composition is too short for the criterion's word test to reach it

headline: 17 of the 30 are text the criterion missed and 13 are genuine. Every one of the 17 is one or two characters, or a two-to-three letter piece of a rotated credit that the annotation cut into several compositions. None of the 30 is a genuine formula that the criterion wrongly flagged, because none of the 30 was flagged at all: this draw measures recall, and the self-check measures precision.
consequence: the mislabel count of 68 is a LOWER BOUND. It is honest about what it finds and silent about short fragments. For this batch's purpose that is the safe direction: the repair is judged by whether the count falls, and a conservative counter cannot manufacture a fall.
